y-m-58-01.s.s1.explain: (가) waa 1→1, 2→2, 3→0, 4→1 (나) na waa 1→0, 2→1, 3→2, 4→3, sidaas darteed dhammaantood waxay leeyihiin hal qiime oo Y ku jira. Gudaha (다), marka x=2 laba qiime, 0 iyo 1, ayaa la isku xiray, sidaas darteed 'si sax ah hal' wuu jabaa, gudaha (라) na, marka x=1, −1 waa Y ka baxsan.
y-m-58-01.s.s2.prompt: Jihu ayaa sheegay in (다) ay tahay shaqo. Dooro khadka khaldan ee dooda Jihu.
y-m-58-01.s.s2.hint.0: Khad kasta calaamadee 'labada shuruudood ee qeexidda' kee ayuu weedhu hubinayaa.
y-m-58-01.s.s2.hint.1: Khad kasta, si gooni ah u hubi imisa qiime ayaa u dhigma x iyo in qiimayaashaasi Y gudaheeda ku jiraan.
y-m-58-01.s.s2.line.0: (다) wuxuu ku xiraa x tirooyinka Y ku jira ee ka yar x.
y-m-58-01.s.s2.line.1: Haddii x=1, tirada keliya ee Y ku jirta ee ka yar 1 waa 0.
y-m-58-01.s.s2.line.2: Haddii x=2, tirooyinka Y ku jira ee ka yar 2 waa 0 iyo 1, laba ka mid ah.
y-m-58-01.s.s2.line.3: Labada qiime labaduba Y ayay ku jiraan, sidaas darteed shuruuddu waa la buuxiyey, (다) na waa shaqo.
y-m-58-01.s.s2.line.4: Sidaas darteed (다) waa shaqo laga bilaabo X ilaa Y.
y-m-58-01.s.s2.explain: Khadka 4 waa khaladka. Shaqo waa inaysan kaliya qiimayaasheeda Y ku lahayn laakiin waa inay x kasta u leedahay 'si sax ah hal'. Labada 0 iyo 1 waxaa lagu xiray x=2, sidaas darteed shaqo ma aha. Khadka 5 waa gunaanad aamina khadka 4, sidaas darteed isaga ayuu la burburaa.
y-m-58-01.s.s3.prompt: Hadda ballaarii aagga qiimaha una dhig Y'={0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8}. Samee shaqo f(x)=px+q (p iyo q waa tirooyin dhan) laga bilaabo X={1, 2, 3, 4} ilaa Y' si x kala duwan loogu xiro qiimayaal kala duwan (p 0 ma aha), oo hel oo geli 3 (p, q) oo kala duwan.
y-m-58-01.s.s3.hint.0: Marka hore dooro hal p, kadibna hel qiimayaasha marka x=1 iyo marka x=4.
y-m-58-01.s.s3.hint.1: Ku dhaqaaji q wax yar mar kasta si labada qiime ay u noqdaan inta u dhexaysa 0 iyo 8 oo ay ku jiraan.
y-m-58-01.s.s3.fail.c1: p iyo q waa inay noqdaan tirooyin dhan.
y-m-58-01.s.s3.fail.c2: Haddii p=0, isla qiime ayaa lagu xiraa x kasta. p waa inaanay noqon 0.
y-m-58-01.s.s3.ok.c3: Qiimaha shaqada ugu yar waa 0 ama ka weyn.
y-m-58-01.s.s3.fail.c3: Qiimaha shaqada marka mid ka mid ah x=1 iyo x=4 waa ka yar 0, sidaas darteed wuxuu ka baxsan yahay Y'.
y-m-58-01.s.s3.ok.c4: Qiimaha hawsha ugu weyn waa 8 ama ka yar.
y-m-58-01.s.s3.fail.c4: Qiimaha hawsha mid ka mid ah x=1 iyo x=4 wuu ka weyn yahay 8, sidaas darteed wuxuu ka baxsan yahay Y'.
y-m-58-01.s.s3.explain: Tusaale ahaan, f(x)=x wuxuu bixiyaa 1 ilaa 4, f(x)=2x−1 wuxuu bixiyaa 1, 3, 5, 7, f(x)=−x+5 na wuxuu bixiyaa 4, 3, 2, 1. Odhaah toosan waxay ku beddelantaa hal jiho oo keliya marka x weynaado, sidaas darteed haddii qiimayaasha x=1 iyo x=4 oo keliya ay Y' ku jiraan, x kasta oo u dhexeeya sidoo kale way ku jiraan.

y-m-58-07.title: Isla xogta, garaaf leh dareen kala duwan
y-m-58-07.topic: Muujinta xogta: isla xogta, garaafyo kala duwan
y-m-58-07.goal: Fahan in qiimaha bilowga iyo kala duwanaanshaha dhidibka toosan ay isla xogta ka dhigaan mid u muuqata si kala duwan, hel oo hagaaji tarjumaad la weyneeyey, oo naftaada dooro cabbir buuxiya shuruud.
y-m-58-07.material: Iibka bille ah (shay) ee dukaan waa 200 Janaayo, 204 Febraayo, 208 Maarso iyo 212 Abriil (xog la samaystay). Maqaalka wargeyska A wuxuu daabacay garaaf xariiq ah oo dhidibka toosan laga sawiray 0 ilaa 250, maqaalka B na wuxuu daabacay garaaf xariiq ah oo dhidibka toosan laga sawiray 198 ilaa 214. Baraha labada garaaf waa isla xogta. Xariijinta garaafka B waxay u egtahay inay si degdeg ah kor ugu kacdo.
y-m-58-07.prereq.0: Akhrinta garaaf xariiq ah (heerka dugsiga dhexe)
y-m-58-07.s.s1.prompt: Dooro dhammaan hadallada run ah ee ku saabsan labada garaaf.
y-m-58-07.s.s1.hint.0: Akhri qiimaha barta Janaayo iyo qiimaha barta Abriil labada garaaf mid walba, oo isbarbar dhig.
y-m-58-07.s.s1.hint.1: Ka fikir sida xaqiiqda ah in kala duwanaanshaha dhidibyada toosan ay kala duwan yihiin u saameyso qaabka jiirka xariijinta.
y-m-58-07.s.s1.o.a: Garaafka B wuxuu u muuqdaa mid ka jiir badan, sidaa darteed iibka dhabta ahi wuxuu ku kordhay si dhakhso ah B
y-m-58-07.s.s1.r.a: Waxaad u akhrisay qaabka garaafka sida farqi xogta ah.
y-m-58-07.s.s1.o.b: Beddelidda bilowga iyo kala fogaanshaha cabbirka dhidibka toosan waxay siin kartaa dareen kala duwan xataa isla xogta
y-m-58-07.s.s1.r.b: Waad ogtahay in sida xogta loo muujiyo ay beddeli karto dareenka, xataa isla xogta.
y-m-58-07.s.s1.o.c: Garaafka B, ee dhidibkiisa toosan aanu ka bilaabmin 0, waa garaaf been ah oo si kala duwan u sawira qiimayaasha xogta
y-m-58-07.s.s1.r.c: Baraha B sidoo kale waxay muujinayaan isla qiimayaasha xogta dhabta ah. Dhibaatadu maaha qiimayaasha ee waa dareenka uu sameeyey cabbirku.
y-m-58-07.s.s1.o.d: Iibka baraha labada garaaf muujinayaan waa isle'eg yihiin
y-m-58-07.s.s1.r.d: Kani waa doorasho xaqiijisa in isla xogta lagu sawiray cabbirro kala duwan.
y-m-58-07.s.s1.explain: Labada garaaf waxay sawiraan kaliya isla xogta iyagoo leh dhidibyo toosan oo kala duwan. Beddelidda dhidibku wuxuu ka dhigi karaa xariijinta mid u muuqata jiir badan, laakiin iibka laftiisu waa isku mid. Dhidib ka bilaabma 0 sidoo kale had iyo jeer ugu fiican maaha (tusaale ahaan, xogta isbeddelo yaryar loo baahan yahay in la muujiyo).
y-m-58-07.s.s2.prompt: Dooro sadarka khaldan ee sharaxaadda wariyaha B ee maqaalka.
y-m-58-07.s.s2.hint.0: Akhri qiimaha u dhigma dhererka 0 garaafka B.
y-m-58-07.s.s2.hint.1: Naftaada hel saamiga iibka Janaayo iyo Abriil.
y-m-58-07.s.s2.line.0: Iibku wuxuu kordhay 4 shay bil kasta: 200, 204, 208, 212.
y-m-58-07.s.s2.line.1: Laga bilaabo Janaayo ilaa Abriil wuxuu kordhay 12, sidaa darteed wuxuu kordhay 6 boqolkiiba qiimihii bilowga.
y-m-58-07.s.s2.line.2: Garaafka B, barta Abriil waa 7 jeer ka sarraysa barta Janaayo, sidaa darteed iibku wuxuu noqday 7 jeer.
y-m-58-07.s.s2.line.3: Sidaa darteed waa la qori karaa in dukaankani aad u dhakhso u koraayo.
y-m-58-07.s.s2.explain: Sadarka 3 waa khalad. Dhidibka toosan ee garaafka B wuxuu ka bilaabmaa 198, sidaa darteed dhererka barta wuxuu muujiyaa kaliya farqiga ka yimid 198 (2 iyo 14). Iibka laftiisu wuxuu ka kacay 200 ilaa 212, taasoo ah 6 boqolkiiba ee ma aha 7 jeer. Sadarka 4 waa gunaanad ku tiirsan khaladkaas.
y-m-58-07.s.s3.prompt: Hadda waxaad rabtaa inaad garaafka maqaalka C si daacad ah u sawirto. Go'aami dhamaadka hoose y0 iyo dhamaadka sare y1 ee dhidibka toosan (labaduba waa isku-dhufashooyin 10, y0 ugu badnaan 200, y1 ugu yaraan 212) si kororka 12 ee laga bilaabo Janaayo ilaa Abriil uu u muuqdo 10% ama ka yar dhererka guud ee dhidibka toosan. Si cabbirku aanu aad u ballaarin, y1−y0 waa ugu badnaan 400. Geli 2 (y0, y1) oo kala duwan.
y-m-58-07.s.s3.hint.0: Isla'eg ku qor boqolkiiba intee le'eg ayuu kororka 12 yahay dhererka guud ee dhidibka toosan.
y-m-58-07.s.s3.hint.1: Ka fikir ugu yaraan intee le'eg ayuu dhidibku waajib yahay inuu dheeraado si saamigaasi u noqdo 10% ama ka yar.

y-m-58-07.s.s3.ok.c2: Xogta 200 ilaa 212 waxay ku habboon tahay dhidibka gudahiisa.
y-m-58-07.s.s3.fail.c2: Xogta 200 ilaa 212 dhammaanteed waa inay ku habboonaadaan dhidibka gudahiisa.
y-m-58-07.s.s3.ok.c3: Kororka 12 waa 10% ama ka yar dhererka dhidibka.
y-m-58-07.s.s3.fail.c3: Dhererka dhidibku waa gaaban yahay, sidaa darteed 12 waxay u muuqataa mid ka badan 10%.
y-m-58-07.s.s3.ok.c4: Dhererka dhidibku waa 400 ama ka yar.
y-m-58-07.s.s3.fail.c4: Dhererka dhidibku waa ka badan yahay 400.
y-m-58-07.s.s3.explain: Haddii dhererka dhidibku yahay 120 ama ka badan, 12 waxay u muuqataa 10% ama ka yar. Tusaalayaal: 0 ilaa 250 (dherer 250) iyo 100 ilaa 300 (dherer 200) labaduba waa suurtagal. Dhidibku uma baahna inuu ka bilaabmo 0; dhererku kaliya waa inuu ku filan yahay.
